anchors: bmk alone, in uv's own tool dir, shared by every project
decision: bmk runs from its own shared uv tool env, which holds bmk alone; project tests run in the project venv.

evidence.text: bmk's own install model since 3.8.0, read from its Makefile when the skill was corrected (48e94f13)

reopen_if: bmk changes where or with what it installs itself (check its CHANGELOG).
why: bmk 3.8.0 moved to this model: with no project dependencies in the env there is nothing left to collide between projects, and pytest runs in the same project venv that pyright and pip-audit inspect, so the suite and the audit describe one environment. The skill first taught the per-project env and had to be rewritten when it described the inverse of what bmk does.

decision: Rejected: resolving bmk together with the project (`--with .`, a per-project bmk env).

evidence.text: the failures bmk 3.8.0 removed the per-project env for, listed in the skill's install section (48e94f13)

reopen_if: bmk's own install model changes (check its CHANGELOG).
why: Resolving bmk together with a project caused, in order: a project dependency capping one of bmk's and silently pinning bmk to an ancient release; a yanked transitive making bmk itself uninstallable; and the tests running in that co-resolved env while pyright and pip-audit inspected the real project venv, so the suite and the audit described different environments.
